title: Gravity A and gravity B in Barry's lab notes
summary: Bob Lazar tells of Gravity A and gravity B in Barry's lab notes, about late 1980s at S4, Nevada, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Barry had um, other lab notes, Mhm. and I don't know if those were previous docu- or documents that he had, but they were lab notes, and these this was the direction they were going in at one time.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret site called S4 in Nevada in the late 1980s, says a colleague named Barry Castilio had other lab notes. According to Lazar, the notes described two kinds of gravity, gravity A and gravity B, and showed a direction the research had taken at one time, though he is not sure where the notes came from. If true, it would give a glimpse of how the craft's propulsion was studied.
